title: 12 Sounding: API observability hero
strengths: Product first: the real Overview screen (product/04) flat and whole on the 1344 px grid, cropped cleanly under its chart legend, inert, with KPI numbers that read; a light window on charcoal is the brightest object with no glow

One confident display line in the on-call engineer's words, 'Find the deploy that broke p95.', at 107 px so its ink runs 43 to ~1390 px, the width of the window above: type and product read as one block

Discipline and proof: one face (Inter, plus mono for the version tag), one button, amber only where the product alerts, and a sentence built only from on-screen facts (v2.41.0 deployed 13:12 UTC; p95 past 450 ms nine minutes later)
slop_signals: The headline's evidence is a ~10 px spike at the right edge of one chart card, next to a 386 ms 24-hour tile that reads as 'fine'; the hero cannot change the product's time range
Little besides the type move and the plumb-line mark is ownable by this brand
107 px is outside the type scale (an exception recorded in notes.md for the owner)
fixes: Product-side: a deploy or alert state on product/04 that opens the charts on the alert's window, so the spike fills the card; set data-theme="light" on its <html>
Optional, if the owner wants more: a nav-level 'Connect a service' so the action shows in a short browser viewport (keep it the same single action)

references.what: Light product window on a dark page; theirs adds an orange highlight line, two buttons and a phone over the window, ours keeps one flat window and one action
Regular-weight headline with a full-width window; theirs uses a glow and a floating modal, ours puts the product first and the claim under it
Bold centred headline over a dashboard on a purple glow; what to avoid

facts: The picture's proof is small (product-side time range); the 386 ms KPI is the 24-hour figure
Product-side: no data-theme on product/04 (OS dark mode flips the embed to its unfinished dark theme); 'Updated 14:02 UTC' also appears in product/06
fixed: Unsupported claims removed: 'works with any OpenTelemetry exporter', 'paged', 'every chart marks the deploy', a causal 'release that took p95 past 450 ms'
Kicker, mono incident logs, tick annotation and caption strips tried and removed after audits found them repetitive or misleading
Headline sized to the window's width; sentence cut to one 20 px line with the category first; nav 'Docs' dropped so it isn't repeated by the product's own bar
Crop set at 548 px (587 product px) under the legend; frame made inert; hover only on fine pointers

owner.said: Hide all 6: approved the round 4 audit's removals (mockups showing removed pieces, heroes repeating the product screens, a generic timer)

changed: New piece: marketing hero for product/04 Sounding, using the product's own system extended with a display set (Q-brand-06 two-sets)
About eighteen fresh-eyes audit rounds: 3 for the copy-above-screen and caption versions, 3.5 to 4 once the product moved first and one display line was measured to the window; confirming score 4
Distinct recipe: the only hero in 11-14 with the product first, a dark page and one grid-wide display line
